_README: Drives scripts/translate-catalogs.js. The sibling web UI has its own copy of this file with its own paths; the script is run from here against either.
context: Short strings spoken aloud by a text-to-speech bot on Twitch and YouTube live streams, or written into stream chat. Register is casual and enthusiastic, matching live-stream culture. Keep messages short: they are read out loud over audio, and chat replies are cut off past 500 characters.

glossary.sub: a paid channel subscription on Twitch, not a submarine or a substitute
glossary.gift sub: a subscription one viewer buys for another
glossary.raid: a streamer sending their audience to another channel at the end of a stream
glossary.cheer: spending Twitch 'bits' to support a streamer
glossary.bits: Twitch virtual currency. Keep the English word rather than translating it, but it MAY inflect: use "bit" for exactly one and "bits" for any other number. In a language that does not inflect loanwords, use whatever single form reads naturally for any count.
glossary.watch streak: consecutive streams a viewer has watched
glossary.redeemed: spent channel points on a reward
glossary.Tier: Twitch subscription level (Tier 1/2/3); keep the English word and the number
